newsitem.title: MEXICO: Invecop shares rise on technicals.
newsitem.headline: Invecop shares rise on technicals.

text.p: The share price on Thursday for Invecop, a Mexican holding company with a heavy interest in insurance companies, was sharply higher largely for technical reasons, a Mexican analyst said.
Invecop's A1 series was up 3.06 percent to 1.01 pesos on heavy volume of 8.2 million shares shortly after 1300 local time (1800 GMT). It peaked earlier at 1.03 pesos.

"Invecop had very strong support between 96 and 98 centavos, and now that it is at 1.03, it should find resistance where certainly some selling will begin," one analyst said just before the stock price moderated.
"When it broke 98 centavos people saw the opportunity to take positions because when the market is apathetic the companies with low nominal value and laggers are the most traded," the analyst said.
The Inbursa brokerage house was buying a lot of Invecop stock, dealers said. The analyst said technical buying was accompanied by speculative buying.
